@rhea From the design review notes I have: exports from the CMS put a space after each delimiter, so spaces between a delimiter (or start of line) and an opening quote are skipped and the field is parsed as quoted: 'id, "Smith, John"' -> ["id", "Smith, John"]. Unquoted fields still keep their spaces (' padded ' stays ' padded '). That should clarify the quoted-field case, but the empty-field contradiction you described (test_plain_and_empty_fields vs test_regression_issue_1032) is about a different edge — trailing empty fields. I'd defer to @qa-team on which test is correct, or check with the original design reviewer.

@noor From the design review notes I have: a value of None renders as an empty string (filters then receive ""), never as the text "None". Other falsy values are rendered normally (0 -> "0", False -> "False"). So 0 should render as "0", and test_paths_and_filters is correct. test_regression_issue_1007 looks like a stale check.
